title: A U.S. Strategy to Secure Geopolitical Advantage on an Uncertain Path to Superintelligence: Maintaining Freedom of Action
summary_en: Frontier artificial intelligence continues to advance, and many experts contend that superintelligence is possible. The authors recommend a Freedom of Action strategy to secure geopolitical advantage and ensure humanity’s survival with agency.
title_cn: A U.S. Strategy to Secure Geopolitical Advantage on an Uncertain Path to Superintelligence: Maintaining Freedom of Action
